title.label: It works, but it's probably always listening to me and selling my data to whoever wants it.

content.label: I'm going to use this app to write this review. So far, it has been able to do pretty much everything that I want it to do. There have been a few mistakes, but much more success. I'm sure it'll get better. I've only just started using it. It does concern me that, since it is free, they have to make their money some other way, so I think they are probably going to spy on you a little bit. But what's a little privacy invasion among large companies and private citizens? I'm lazy. I use Siri, and I don't like to proofread. I just hit send. Recently, though, it sounds like I'm having a brain tumor, so this has been an improvement.
